evidence.description: CRIT-009 through CRIT-012 state binary pass thresholds for integer minor units, real PostgreSQL rejection paths, the exact closed UI model, and corrective regression/traceability evidence.
The criteria match REQ-008 integer/non-zero-revision invariants, REQ-010 fail-closed four-organ rendering, and REQ-012 regression preservation without expanding sprint scope.

The executable database harness covers zero revision keys, fractional append input, fractional direct insertion, zero-row persistence after rejection, exact retries, role boundaries, snapshot concurrency, and 20000/20001 limits.

The executable renderer tests cover missing and extra organs, extra outer fields, numeric and impossible timestamps, malformed period kinds, contradictory ratios, duplicate references, and incomplete components.
The ledger stores amount_minor as unconstrained-scale numeric with explicit truncation and JavaScript safe-integer bounds at both the table constraint and append-function validation boundary.
The renderer enforces the exact outer/organs/organ/component key sets and canonical UTC millisecond timestamps before rendering exactly four cards.
The review boundary cleanly separates the two authoritative specs, executable tests/evidence, and the two corrective source surfaces plus traceability state.
The corrective criteria preserve the persistence-shell and presentation-shell boundaries defined by the verification architecture.
Recorded GREEN evidence provides passing UI, PostgreSQL, full regression, panel-score 14/14, and deterministic eval totals matching CRIT-012.

Traceability records TEST-017 through TEST-019 green, IMPL-006 and IMPL-007 implemented, and FIND-001 through FIND-003 resolved; a fresh validateChainCompleteness probe returns valid true with no warnings.
